summary_ja: 自己居住用・賃貸用・事業用のいずれでもない不動産担保付エクスポージャーで、LTV比率六十以下かつ適格性の要件を満たすものを六十パーセントとすることができる。
summary_en: Other real-estate-secured exposures (not residential, rental or commercial as defined) with LTV ≤ 60 that meet the eligibility requirements may take 60%.

terms.ja: その他不動産関連エクスポージャー

paragraphs: Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 30 and Article 31 through Article 34, the risk weight of exposures for the construction, acquisition, extension or renovation of real estate and other real-estate-related expenses, or for the management of real estate, that satisfy all of the following requirements and that satisfy all of the eligibility requirements (referred to as "other real estate exposures" in the following paragraph) may be 60%. (i) That it is not an exposure to owner-occupied residential real estate, etc., an exposure to rental residential real estate or a commercial real estate exposure. (ii) That a mortgage or other security interest has been created on the real estate that is the object of the credit. (iii) That the LTV ratio is 60 or less.

The provisions of Article 36, paragraph (3) (excluding item (ii)) shall apply mutatis mutandis where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach determines the risk weight of other real estate exposures under the provisions of the preceding paragraph. In this case, the term "the preceding two paragraphs" in paragraph (3) of that Article shall be read as "Article 37-2, paragraph (1)", and the term "mortgage" in item (i) of that paragraph shall be read as "mortgage or other security interest".

The "LTV ratio" in paragraph (1), item (iii) means the value, expressed as a percentage, of the ratio obtained by dividing the amount specified in item (i) by the amount specified in item (ii). (i) The amount of the exposure as of the calculation reference date on which the risk weight specified in paragraph (1) is applied; provided, however, that where the mortgage or other security interest is second-ranking or lower, it shall be that exposure amount plus the amount of exposures as of the calculation reference date secured by the property pledged to holders of prior-ranking and equal-ranking mortgages or other security interests (excluding the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach itself). (ii) The amount calculated, by a method satisfying the requirements listed in Article 36, paragraph (3), item (iv) as applied mutatis mutandis under the preceding paragraph, as the value of the property pledged as collateral at the time the credit was extended. In this case, where the case listed in (a) applies, that amount shall be revised downward, and where the case listed in (b) applies, that amount may be revised upward. (a) Where a permanent decrease in the value of the property due to an idiosyncratic event is evident. (b) Where the value of the property increases due to extension or renovation.
